role: AK_TEXT (lines and table rows); MODERN_EDITORIAL (the editor's numbers, brackets, note marks and folio references; his footnotes not reproduced)
comment: Frame 148, printed p. 142: the spring that flows into the river رنوس concluded; a river out of the river ديوس to the sea; the river نويس, from a spring between the towns نياقيلون and اراطى and between ورقس and انردس to the sea, with the six rivers that go out of it to the sea and a river out of it past the towns داطه, دواسس and اكلس back into it. The editor's running numbers (٢١٤٢)-(٢١٦١), five of them given as a range, and the numbers of Suhrāb; a word supplied by the editor between angle brackets. Three lines of the editor's footnotes.

lines.plain: بركن مدينة اكلس فيقع فى النهر الّذى يخرج منه عند طول مز ل والعرض مه ō

variants: L04: the manuscript is unclear at the longitude; the editor suggests that it may perhaps be read كط ل, with a line over the numerals (note a).
L04: a variant reading of the latitude is مو ل, with a line over the numerals (note b).
L13: the word between the brackets is missing in the manuscript; the editor supplies it (note c).
L14: the manuscript has only خ for the word «خمسة» (note d).
L15: a variant reading of the latitude is مز ō, with the dot of the ز and a line over the numerals (note e).
L16: a variant reading of the name is راطه (note f).
L16: a variant reading of the name is دواٮسس, with a tooth without a dot after the alif and then the teeth of two س (note g).
L17: the manuscript is unclear; the editor suggests that the name may perhaps be read اٮحلس (note h).
observations: The spring that flows into the river رنوس goes on from p. 141 (frame 147), whose last words, «ويصبّ الى هٰذا النهر عين اوّلها عند طول كو م والعرض نا ل», and into this river flows a spring whose beginning is at the longitude 26° 40′ and the latitude 51° 30′, L01 continues with the running number of that point and «ومصبّها عند طول كح م والعرض مط مه (٢١٤٣) *», and its mouth is at the longitude 28° 40′ and the latitude 49° 45′.

L02-L03: «ويخرج من نهر ديوس نهر ايضاً اوّله عند طول كط {z} والعرض ٮه ك (٢١٤٤) ومصبّه فى البحر عند طول كح {z} والعرض نو ك (٢١٤٥) *», and out of the river ديوس comes also a river whose beginning is at the longitude 29° 0′ and the latitude ٮه ك, and its mouth in the sea at the longitude 28° 0′ and the latitude 56° 20′. «ديوس» is the river printed «رنوس» on p. 141 (frame 147, L12), whose name the editor's note e there gives at this point (2144) as ديوس.

L04-L10: «نهر نويس اوّله عين عند طول كط ك والعرض مو ك (٢١٤٦)», the river نويس, whose beginning is a spring at the longitude 29° 20′ and the latitude 46° 20′; «يمرّ فيما بين نياقيلون ومدينة اراطى يمرّ الى موضع طوله م م والعرض مز يه (٢١٤٧)», it passes between نياقيلون and the town اراطى and passes to a place whose longitude is 40° 40′ and the latitude 47° 15′; «ويمرّ فيما بين مدينة ورقس ومدينة انردس الى موضع طوله مب {z} والعرض مح {z} (٢١٤٨)», and it passes between the town ورقس and the town انردس to a place whose longitude is 42° 0′ and the latitude مح ō; «ويمرّ الى موضع طوله مد {z} والعرض مو {z} (٢١٤٩)», to a place whose longitude is 44° 0′ and the latitude 46° 0′; «ويمرّ الى موضع طوله مز ل والعرض مه {z} (٢١٥٠)», to a place whose longitude is 47° 30′ and the latitude 45° 0′; «ويمرّ الى موضع طوله مح {z} والعرض مو {z} (٢١٥١)», to a place whose longitude is مح ō and the latitude 46° 0′; «ويمرّ الى موضع طوله مز ل والعرض مح ل (٢١٥٢)», to a place whose longitude is 47° 30′ and the latitude مح ل; «ويمرّ فيصبّ فى البحر عند طول ٮا {z} والعرض ٮا م (٢١٥٣) *», and it passes and flows into the sea at the longitude ٮا ō and the latitude ٮا م.

The towns are entries of the table of the cities (frame 039): 476, «⟨ماڡلو⟩ٮ مع الجبل» (L04), at the longitude لٮ ك and the latitude 47° 30′, whose name the editor supplies and whose form at this point (2147) he gives as نياقيلون; 477, «اراطى» (L05), at the longitude لٮ ل and the latitude 47° 0′; 480, «ابيردبين» (L08), at the longitude 40° 45′ and the latitude مح ك, and 481, «ورقيس» (L09), at the longitude مٮ ō and the latitude مز ٮه, whose forms at (2148) he gives as انردس and ورقس.

L11-L14: «ويخرج من هٰذا النهر ستّة انهار وتصبّ فى البحر», and out of this river come six rivers, and they flow into the sea; «اوّل الأنهار مخرجه من طول مح مه والعرض مط ن (٢١٥٤) مصبّه فى البحر عند طول ٮا {z} والعرض مط {z} (٢١٥٥)», the first of the rivers: its exit is from the longitude مح مه and the latitude 49° 50′, its mouth in the sea at the longitude ٮا ō and the latitude 49° 0′; «والأنهار الخمسة ⟨مصابّها⟩ فيما بين مصبّ هٰذا النهر ومصبّ النهر الكبير الأوّل على استواء خمسة اقسام (٢١٥٦—٢١٦٠) *», and the five rivers, ⟨their mouths⟩ are between the mouth of this river and the mouth of the first, great river, at equal intervals, in five parts. The running numbers (٢١٥٦)-(٢١٦٠) and the numbers of Suhrāb [٢٠٧٦]-[٢٠٨٠] of the five mouths are printed as ranges, each within one pair of brackets, with a long dash between the first and the last number; transcribed as printed.

L15-L17: «ويخرج من هٰذا النهر الأوّل الكبير نهر من موضع طوله مد {z} والعرض مو {z} (٢١٦١)», and out of this first, great river comes a river from a place whose longitude is 44° 0′ and the latitude 46° 0′; «ويمرّ بقرب اسفل مدينة داطه ويمرّ بركن مدينة دواسس ويمرّ بركن مدينة اكلس فيقع فى النهر الّذى يخرج منه عند طول مز ل والعرض مه {z}», it passes near the lower part of the town داطه, passes the corner of the town دواسس and the corner of the town اكلس, and falls into the river out of which it comes, at the longitude 47° 30′ and the latitude 45° 0′, the running number of this point following on p. 143. The towns are entries 445, «داطيه», at the longitude 45° 20′ and the latitude 44° 45′; 447, «دواٮسس», at the longitude مر ن and the latitude 44° 20′; and 448, «ايخلس», at the longitude 47° 45′ and the latitude 45° 0′, of the table of the cities (frame 037, L01, L03, L04), where the editor's notes give the forms of these names at (2162): داطه, with the variant reading راطه; the form of the table, with a variant reading; and اكلس, with his suggestion of a reading.

L16: «دواسس»: after the alif, two groups of three low teeth, 8 to 12 px high, with a wider gap between them (19 px, where the teeth of a group stand 10 to 12 px apart), the second running into the final bowl: two س. The editor's note g prints «دواٮسس»: after the alif a tooth without a dot, 18 px high, then the teeth of two س, as the table prints the name (frame 037, L03). L17: «اكلس», the ك with its long upper stroke. L04: «نويس», the ن with its dot, the ي with its two dots run together into one mark of 18 by 11 px. L06: «ورقس», the ق with its two dots; «انردس», the ن with its dot. L05: «نياقيلون», all its dots printed; «اراطى» ends in a ى without dots.

Note h prints the suggested reading «اٮحلس»: the alif, a tooth without a dot, 17 px high, the ح, the ل and the final س, the foot of the ل joined to the س. The editor's note c on frame 037 prints the same reading with the tall stroke standing 2 px apart from the س, «اٮحاس».

Numerals: «كح م» (L01), 28° 40′; «مط مه» (L01), 49° 45′; «كط {z}» (L02), 29° 0′; «كح {z}» (L03), 28° 0′; «نو ك» (L03), with the dot of the ن, 56° 20′; «كط ك» (L04), 29° 20′; «مو ك» (L04), 46° 20′; «م م» (L05), 40° 40′; «مز يه» (L05), with the dot of the ز and the two dots of the ي run together into one mark of 18 by 11 px, the minutes printed close to the degrees under one line, 47° 15′; «مب {z}» (L06), with the dot of the ب, 42° 0′; «مد {z}» (L07, L15), 44° 0′; «مو {z}» (L07, L09, L15), 46° 0′; «مز ل» (L08, L09, L17), with the dot of the ز, 47° 30′; «مه {z}» (L08, L17), 45° 0′; «مط ن» (L12), with the dot of the ن, 49° 50′; «مط {z}» (L12), 49° 0′.

Without their dots, transcribed so: «ٮه ك» (L02): the degrees are a tooth without its dot joined to a final ه, 31 by 28 px, where the isolated ه is a small round ring of about 18 by 20 px: ٮه, 55 read with a ن, 15 with a ي (frame 113, L08; frame 031, L07); read as نه, 55° 20′, beside the mouth of the river at 56° 20′. «ٮا {z}» (L10, L12) and «ٮا م» (L10): a tooth without its dot joined to an alif, 51 read with a ن, 11 with a ي; read with ن, 51° 0′ and 51° 40′, in the seventh clime, which begins at the latitude 48° (frame 039, L01), and beside the latitude 49° 50′ of the place from which the first of the six rivers comes out.

«مح {z}» (L06, L09), «مح ل» (L09) and «مح مه» (L12): the ح shows no dot in the bowl; the same form is a ج without its dot, 3. Read with ح they give 48° 0′, 48° 30′ and 48° 45′, beside the towns ورقس at the latitude مز ٮه and انردس at مح ك in the table (frame 039, L08, L09) and the other longitudes of the river, 47° 30′ (L08, L09) and 51° (L10). «كح» (L01, L03), 28.
Angle brackets, followed by the note mark c, around what the editor supplies: «⟨مصابّها⟩» (L13). Transcribed with the brackets.

Signs in the text, transcribed as printed: «ومصبّها» (L01), «ومصبّه» (L03), «فيصبّ» (L10), «وتصبّ» (L11), «مصبّه» (L12) and «مصبّ» (L13, twice) with a shadda over the ب, and «⟨مصابّها⟩» (L13) with a shadda over the ب; «ايضاً» (L02) with the tanwin of the accusative over its alif; «اوّله» (L02, L04) and «اوّل» (L11) with a shadda over the و; «الأوّل» (L14, L15) with a hamza over the alif and a shadda over the و; «يمرّ» (L04, L05) and «ويمرّ» (L05, L07, L08, twice; L09, L10, L16, twice) with a shadda over the ر; «هٰذا» (L11, L13, L15) with a small alif over the ه; «ستّة» (L11) with a shadda over the ت; «الأنهار» (L11) and «والأنهار» (L13) with a hamza over the alif; «استواء» (L14) with a hamza on the line; «الّذى» (L17) with a shadda over the ل; «فى», «الى», «اراطى» (L05) and «الّذى» end in a ى without dots.

The running numbers run (٢١٤٢)-(٢١٦١) without a gap, (٢١٥٦)-(٢١٦٠) given as one range. The numbers of Suhrāb: [٢٠٦٠] and [٢٠٦١] after (٢١٤٢) and (٢١٤٣); [٢٠٦٤] and [٢٠٦٥] after (٢١٤٤) and (٢١٤٥), [٢٠٦٢] and [٢٠٦٣] standing at points 2138-2139 on p. 141; [٢٠٦٦]-[٢٠٧٥] after (٢١٤٦)-(٢١٥٥); the range [٢٠٧٦—٢٠٨٠]; and [٢٠٨١] after (٢١٦١). (٢١٤٢), (٢١٤٨), (٢١٥٢), (٢١٥٥) and (٢١٦١) stand at the beginning of L01, L07, L10, L13 and L16, and [٢٠٧٣] at the beginning of L11, after the running number (٢١٥٣) at the end of L10.
Asterisks: the small open stars with six points, after [٢٠٦١] (L01), [٢٠٦٥] (L03), [٢٠٧٣] (L11) and [٢٠٧٦—٢٠٨٠] (L14), are transcribed as asterisks.

Note marks: L04, a after the longitude and b after the latitude; L13, c after «⟨مصابّها⟩»; L14, d after «خمسة»; L15, e after the latitude; L16, f after «داطه» and g after «دواسس»; L17, h after «اكلس».
Marks not transcribed: L10, a short horizontal stroke, 27 px wide, crossing the top of the alif of «ٮا {z}», below the line over the numerals; small specks of the impression around the numerals.
The editor's footnotes stand in three lines below a short rule at the left: notes a-h. The page number «— ١٤٢ —» stands at the foot, centred.
